name: Princess Bubblegum
title: Ruler of the Candy Kingdom
description:
Princess Bubblegum, often called PB, is the intelligent and capable ruler of the Candy Kingdom. She is one of the most complex characters in Adventure Time because she combines kindness, leadership, science, and control in ways that often create moral tension. She cares deeply about her kingdom and its citizens, but she can also be secretive, cold, and willing to make questionable decisions if she thinks they are necessary.

She is a brilliant scientist and inventor, and much of her power comes from her intelligence rather than physical strength. PB is constantly experimenting, building machines, solving problems, and trying to maintain order in a world that is often chaotic. Her scientific mind makes her different from many other rulers in Ooo, but it also sometimes causes her to treat people like pieces of a larger system rather than individuals.

Over time, the series shows more of her emotional side, especially through her history with Marceline. Their relationship reveals that PB is not just a strict ruler or a genius, but also someone with vulnerability, regrets, and emotional depth. Princess Bubblegum is important because she represents the tension between responsibility and freedom, logic and emotion, and care and control.
